name: zsh
description: zsh shell discipline: globbing and qualifiers, options (setopt), 1-indexed arrays, startup-file order, and the differences from bash. Pair with the bash pack for the shared rules.

differences.summary: zsh vs bash: no word splitting, nomatch globs, 1-indexed arrays, parameter flags, bash-only constructs and their zsh forms

globbing.summary: zsh globbing: ** recursion, qualifiers (.) (/) (N) (om) (m-7) (L+1), extended_glob ^ ~ #, and when to still use find

options.summary: setopt/unsetopt that change script behaviour: err_exit, pipe_fail, null_glob, no_unset, sh_word_split, ksh_arrays, and emulate -L

config.summary: zsh startup files and order (.zshenv .zprofile .zshrc .zlogin), what scripts do not load, macOS default shell notes, oh-my-zsh pitfalls for automation
